description.value:
Your pawns are more expendable than adventurers and can serve as a first line of defense while you explore dangerous areas. While you're using Take Control as an exploration activity, you get a check to find traps that normally require you to be Searching. You still need to meet any other requirements to find the trap. You gain a circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find traps equal to the number of pawns you're controlling.

If you would trigger a device or set off a trap (whether because you failed to disarm it or triggered it normally), you can use your reaction to have a Controlled pawn trigger it in your place.

Not yet automated: apply the Perception bonus by hand (it equals the maestro's number of Controlled pawns).
